tesla_transition_basic_title: Cambios en datos en vivo de Tesla
tesla_transition_basic_description:
Tesla está cambiando su servicio de conexión y empezará a cobrar por las actualizaciones de datos. A partir del 1 de febrero, los datos en vivo de tu Tesla pasarán a modo básico (actualizaciones de SoC cada 5 minutos) a menos que actualices a ABRP Premium. Con Premium obtienes:

• Datos en vivo en tiempo real
• Calibración del consumo de tu vehículo
• Datos en vivo de velocidad
• Estimación de degradación de batería
• Temperatura del vehículo, exterior y batería
• ... y todas las demás funciones Premium

obdble_connection_failed_checklist:
Por favor, revisa lo siguiente:

• ¿El dongle OBD está correctamente conectado al puerto OBD de tu coche?
• ¿Tu coche está encendido o en modo accesorio?
• ¿El dongle OBD está conectado a otra app? Si es así, desconéctalo primero.
• Prueba a quitar el dongle y volver a insertarlo.
• Asegúrate de que el Bluetooth esté activado en tu dispositivo.
• Prueba a reiniciar el Bluetooth en tu dispositivo.

Si el problema persiste, por favor reporta un error.

obdble_setup_step1_link: If you haven't purchased one yet, <url>read more about choosing an OBD device here</url>.

obdble_setup_warning_body: Rivian, LLC is not liable for any special, incidental, indirect, or consequential damages related to your use or inability to use the ABRP OBD Connection feature.
obdble_setup_step2_body1: Get into the driver's seat with your BLE OBD-adapter.
obdble_setup_step2_body2: Make sure your phone's Bluetooth is turned on.
obdble_setup_step3_body1: Locate your vehicle's On-Board Diagnostics (OBD) port and insert the adapter. Check your owner's manual if you have trouble finding it.
obdble_setup_step3_body2: Turn your vehicle's power on to activate the adapter.
obdble_unsupported_device_body: This model isn't supported. To continue, please choose a different device or check our <url>Choosing an OBD device</url> article.
obdble_scan_failed: Failed to scan for OBD devices. Please try again.
no_server_connection_message: Please check your internet connection and try again.
session_error_message: There was a problem with your session. Please try again later.
find_chargers_min_stalls_description: Show only locations with at least this many stalls
oauth_error_blocked_request: This connection request was blocked because it is not valid. Please start again from the app you were using.
obd_pid_map_results_description: Map certain equation results to a specified value.
obd_pid_mapping_default_hint: Use "default" to match all unspecified results
obd_pid_duplicate_not_saved: Not saved: this command already exists
obd_pid_invalid_not_saved: Not saved: command details are incomplete or invalid
live_data_connect_description: Connect your vehicle to a live data source to get accurate battery status and live route estimates.
live_data_method_enode_description: Connects to vehicle APIs via manufacturers' own services over cellular network
live_data_method_enode_footnote: Most vehicles require an active manufacturer data subscription to work.
live_data_method_obd_description: Connect your vehicle to your iOS or Android device via BLE (Bluetooth Low Energy) using a user-installed OBD-adapter
live_data_method_automotive_description: Provides live data directly from your vehicle's built-in Android Automotive system while you drive.
capability_driving_data_description: State of Charge and position while driving
no_data_received_last_7_days: No data received in last 7 days
disconnect_live_data_message: Are you sure you want to disconnect your vehicle? You will lose access to live data.
car_scanner_step1_title: Open the Car Scanner app on your phone
car_scanner_step1_body: If you haven't downloaded the app yet, download it on the App Store.
car_scanner_step2_item1: In Car Scanner go to settings
car_scanner_step2_item3: Check ABRP telemetry integration and add vehicle token
live_data_method_carscanner_description: Car Scanner connects to your vehicle via Bluetooth and send real-time data to ABRP
live_data_method_generic_description: Send live data to ABRP from your own integration using a vehicle token
obdble_help_bullet_plugged: • The adapter is properly plugged into your car's OBD port
obdble_help_bullet_car_on: • Your car is turned on and not in accessory mode
obdble_help_bullet_other_app: • The OBD adapter isn't connected to another app
obdble_help_bullet_bt_enabled: • Bluetooth is enabled on your iOS or Android device
obdble_help_persist_lead: If the issues persist, try the following:
obdble_help_bullet_bt_cycle: • Turn off and turn back on Bluetooth on your iOS or Android device
obdble_help_closing: If the issues persist, please report a bug.
car_scanner_step1_body_android: If you haven't downloaded the app yet, download it on Google Play.
